strings.privacy.title: Tinfekiyin
strings.privacy.description: Amek i d-yessufuy pdffusion ifuyla-inek: ulac amiḍan, ulac afaylu i d-yettwaḥarzen, ulac adellel neɣ azuzzel n isefka.
strings.privacy.intro: pdffusion yettwabna akken ifuyla-inek ad qqimen d inek. Atan, s wawalen n yal ass, ayen i yedrun mi tesseqdaceḍ.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Ifuyla-inek
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ttwaznen s tbaḍnit (HTTPS), ttwasefreken s uwurman, sin akin ttwaksen akken kan ara yewjed uyennan. Ifuyla imeqqranen tteddun s usagen n wakud s yisem n wawal d ttwaksen akken kan ara kfu usefrek; asizdeg awurman ikkes ayen yezmer ad d-yeqqim deg 24 n tsaɛtin.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Ulac amiḍan, ulac isefka n wudem
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdffusion ur d-isuter ara tira, ulac tansa n imayl neɣ takart n ukredit. Ifuyla-inek ur ttwaryen ara, ur ttwazrawen ara, ur ttwazzanen ara neɣ ur ttwaseqdacen ara i usileɣ n tussna tasnawt.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Asikel n tarrayt
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Nettasiḍen tirziwin war isem d war ikukiyen (Vercel Web Analytics) akken ad nisin anwi ifecka i iɛawnen. Ulac adellel, ulac asurrif gar ismel.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Inagan n teẓrit (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Akuki yiwen, ixeddmen s yiwen n ufran: yettmekta-d tutlayt i d-tferneḍ.

strings.legal.terms.description: pdffusion d ilelli i yal amdan, d tiddukla d unabaḍ. Ifuyla-inek qqimen d inek: ulac win yezrin neɣ yettwaṭṭfen.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Tiwtilin-agi sbeddent aseqdec n pdffusion. Gant s uzraf d imezwura. S useqdec n usmel, tqebleḍ-tent.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Anwa i d-yesseufɣen pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdffusion yesnulfat, yesbedd-it yerna yesseufɣ-it-id Mikailou Cedric Toure, amyazen yeddren deg New Brunswick, Kanada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Asirag n useqdec ilellati i yal amdan
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdffusion d ilellari, war tira neɣ lweqt iɛeddan, i yal amdan: meden, imnuda, iselmaden, tiddukliwin, tiwunak, d inabaḍen deg Kanada neɣ deg tmurt nniḍen. Ulac aseqdec yettwassnen i weswir yettwajaṛen, acku ur yelli ara. Ifuyla ara d-teffɣen d inek: ur sɛin ara tamnadalt neɣ isem n pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Gaɛ ifuyla-inek, ula d wid yemmden
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Tzemreḍ ad tesneɣteḍ yal afaylu, ula d wid yemmden, acku pdffusion ur d-yeɣri ara, ur d-yesnadi ara, ur d-yeṭṭef ara neɣ ur d-yebḍi ara ifuyla-inek: ttwasekneḍ s wudem awurman sakin ttwakksen. Teqqimeḍ d bab-nsen, yerna tella tɣellist-ik ma tessaweḍ ad tesneɣteḍ-ten.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Aɣbalu n ukaram d usebded deg tansa-k
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Aɣbalu n ukaram n pdffusion yeffeɣ ddaw usirag MIT. Tzemreḍ ad t-tɣeriḍ, ad t-tesnadiḍ, ad t-tesbeddeḍ deg tansa-k (ula deg uẓeṭṭa aqeflan war Internet), ad t-tesnifel d uɣtu s baṭel, ma tḥeǧǧeḍ talwit n bab-is d usirag.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Aseqdec iwatan
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Ur tzemreḍ ara ad tesquqreḍ pdffusion i yir tigawt, ad tɛerḍeḍ ad tmesxeḍ anagraw (asali n ifuyla s waṭas, aɛraḍ n unekcum) neɣ ad tɛeddiḍ tilisa tinaktikin. Tilisa n tɣara d wemḍan n ifuyla ḥerrzen anagraw i yal amdan.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Talwit
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdffusion yettunefk s baṭel. Yezmer ad yettwasnifel, ad yeḥbes i uɛewwel neɣ ad yettwakkes. Ḥǧǧu daymen ifuyla-inek imezwura: pdffusion ur d-yeṭṭef ara aɣmis.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Asirag d tallelt
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Anagraw yettunefk akken yella “akken i t-id-yeqqim”, war usirag n wanda yebɣu ili. S wudem afellay i d-yessufeɣ usaḍuf, aneflal ur yesɛi ara tallelt i tarrayin timiɣisin, tukksa n yisefka neɣ taɣara n usnefli ur yemmed ara. Ssenqed ifuyla-inek uqbel ad ten-tesquqreḍ i kra yesɛan azal.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Tazmert tasertit
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Isem n pdffusion, tamnadalt-is d yiḍrisen n usmel d wid n unfelal; aɣbalu yella ddaw usirag MIT akken i d-yenna ufella. Ismawen n tedtamna (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint...) d wid n yibab-nsen.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Asaḍuf n usenqed
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Tiwtilin-agi ttwasebeddent s yisuḍaf n ugezdu n New Brunswick d yisuḍaf n unabaḍ n Kanada. Tiwunak n New Brunswick sɛan azref, war ma yeṭṭef izrfan i k-d-yefka usaḍuf n tmurt-ik d amdan.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Isnifilen
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Tiwtilin-agi zemrent ad ttwaweɛdent. Azemz n ufella yeskanay lqem iɣef tella; asnifel yettwaɣ yakan ad yeddu d aseqdec deffir tuffɣa-s.

strings.legal.security.title: Taɣellist d yisefka
strings.legal.security.description: D acu i yeḍru d ifuyla-inek ɣef pdffusion: asnefli awurman, ur d-yettili usnadi, tukksa s tazzla, asneɣnu, asideg deg Turuft, d uferru n usbedded deg tansa-k.
strings.legal.security.intro: D acu i yeḍru d ifuyla-inek, anda i ttwasekneḍ d wamek i ttwamnaɣen: yesfhem s wudem afellay, i meden d yimagraten.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Ulac ifuyla yettwattefen
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Ifuyla-inek ttwasekneḍ s wudem awurman, sakin ttwakksen kan akken tufɣa tewjed neɣ tettwasali. Ulac aɣmis, ulac aɣmis n uḥraz d umezruy. Asired awurman n yal ass yessufeɣ daɣen yal afaylu n uzgen i yezmer ad d-yeqqim, ass nniḍen i tikkelt.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Ulac asnadi
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Ulac win iɣran ifuyla-inek. Ur ttwaseknen ara, ur ttwasnanen ara, ur ttwaweɛden ara neɣ ur ttwasqeqren ara i usileɣ n tsenseɣrit. pdffusion ur yesɛi ara amiḍan, ur yesɛi ara tuzzma, ur yesɛi ara tiɣula n yiseqdacen.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Asneɣnu
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Yal tuqqna tella ttwaseɣnu (HTTPS) yerna anagraw yessuter asneɣnu deg yal tirza (HSTS). Isenqeden n Uḥraz isneɣnu PDF-inek s AES-256; awal uffir i tferneḍ ur yettwaḥrez ara.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Anda i ttwaḍferen ifuyla-inek
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Asmel, PDF d yibenyrin n tugniwin: Vercel, ammas n yisefka n Paris (Fransa, Tadukli n Turuft). Asnefli n Word, Excel d PowerPoint: Render, deg Frankfurt (Almanya, Tadukli n Turuft). Ifuyla iɛeddan 4 MB: aḥraz n uzgen Vercel Blob, s yisem n uɣmis, yettwakkes deffir useqdec.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Iɣbula n teɣellist
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Isikanen n teɣellist (HSTS, akyas n usmel ad yettuɣal deg yisebtar nniḍen, aḥraz mgal tixidas n talɣa n yifuyla), tansa n yifuyla n uzgen ur nettwaɛqal ara, d unagraw n usnefli i iqeblel kan tiɣriwin yesɛan azamul uffir. Yal asnifel n ukaram yettwasenqed s wudem awurman (tarrayin, asenqed n talɣa) uqbel tuffɣa.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Tabaḍnit d usaḍuf i yeddan
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdffusion yeffeɣ-d deg New Brunswick yerna yedda d Usaḍuf n Uḥraz n Yisefka Udmawanen d Yifuyla Ilikturaniyen n Kanada (PIPEDA). Ur yesmuna ara isefka udmawanen ɣef yiseqdacen-is: ulac amiḍan, ulac tansa n imayl, ulac anagan n teẓrit n unadi. Yettwasebded ɣef yiseɣlanen imezwura am RGPD n Turuft d Usaḍuf 25 n Quebec: taɣara n yisefka, ur ten-ssuqur ara, tukksa deffir usegzi.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: I teddukliwin yesɛan tiwtilin tiɣezzfanin
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Ma yella tiwtilin-ik ur d-ssurafen ara ad taziḍ ifuyla ɣer unagraw berra, sbedd pdffusion deg tansa-k. Akaram ammid d ilellri, d aɣbalu n ukaram yeqqen yerna yetteddu war tuqqna n Internet: ulac afaylu i d-yeffɣen seg uẓeṭṭa-k. Aheggi n usbedded yella deg usebter n unadi.

strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Aɣbalu ammid n ukaram d uzayeɣ: terbaɛt n teɣellist-ik tzemreḍ ad tesenqed yal awal seg waya.

strings.legal.accessibility.title: Tallunt
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Awal n tallunt n pdffusion: amsevdel WCAG 2.2 aswir AA, tarrayin n usbedded, tilisa i nettwassen d wamek ara d-tiniḍ aɣbel.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Yal amdan yessefk ad yezmer ad iseqdec pdffusion, ula d wid ẓeɛfen neɣ ur nwala ara, wid ur nesli ara neɣ isɛan aɣbel n tɣuri.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Aswir n usemday
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdffusion yeɛreḍ ad yeddu d Tiwtilin n Tallunt n Yisuḍaf n Web (WCAG) 2.2, aswir AA, aswir agraɣlan W3C. Aswir-agi yesnulfa tiwtilin n Usaḍuf n Tallunt n Web n Unabaḍ n Kanada, aswir aɣelnaw EN 301 549 d Tiwtiliin 508 deg Yiwunak Yeddukklen, i d-yessawalen ɣer WCAG 2.0 neɣ 2.1 aswir AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Aswir n usemday
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdffusion yedda d kra kan d WCAG 2.2 aswir AA: tilisa i nettwasen ttwabderent ddaw-a. Awal-agi yettwabedded ɣef usenqed agensan i yellan ass n 2 Ɣuct 2026, s yibenyrin n wudmawen (axe, Lighthouse) d usenqed s ufus (taγult, amgarad, asnerni, aɣmis). Ulac asenqed uzgaw i d-yellan armi tura.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: D acu i yellan
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Ammid n usmel yetteddu s tɣult, s uɣmis “Zger ɣer ugbur” d uneggaru ibanen deg uferdis yedduren. Amgarad n uḍris yella akken yili 4.5:1. Isteɣli n tigawt (asali, tufɣa, tuccḍa) ttwawalen i yimeɣriyen n ugdil. Azun n yifuyla yezmer ad yettwasnifel war ad t-tẓummeḍ, s tqennict. Asmel yeddu d waddad “semẓi amussu” n unagar-ik: imussuyen ttwaxsen s ummid. Isebtar qqimen ttwandaren s 400% n usnerni d yiburtaliyen. Tutlayt n yal asebter tettwasebded, d taɛrabt tettwaskan s ufus aẓeẓẓay ɣer uẓeẓẓay.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Tilisa i nettwasen
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: War azenziw-agi, imussuyen n uẓeɣlu (aswir, amuzzɣu, amekkan n talɣa) tteddun s wudem awurman; amuzzɣu yeḥbes ɣef usenqed d tɣult. Amuzzɣu amussu n usebter amezwaru yetteddu s tɣult neɣ s ufus; d uẓeɣlu, yerna ummuɣ n telɣiwin i d-yeskanay yella daɣen s uḍris deg usebter. Tutlayin i d-ttwataramen s unagraw zemrent ad sɛint tuccḍimin. Niɣ, tallunt n ufaylu i d-yeffɣen teɣli ɣef unṣib: pdffusion ur d-yesnarni ara isikano n tallunt i PDF ur nesɛi ara.

strings.tools.redimensionner.seoDescription: Sewwet tugna (s % neɣ s yipiksilen) neɣ ẓẓel-itt d amkuẓ, 16:9 neɣ 4:3, dɣa ḥrez-itt d JPG, PNG neɣ WebP. Baṭel, war asekcem.
strings.tools.redimensionner.intro: Srusu tugniwin-inek, fren ad tent-tesewteḍ neɣ ad tent-tẓẓleḍ, wali tasemlit, dɣa sit ɣef Beddel teɣzi / Ẓẓel. Yelha i tugna n tmunelt, ticeḍt taẓarant neɣ taseknit i yesran teɣzi tunṣibt.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.mode.label: Acu ara txgdeḍ?
Kkes iɣefawen akken ad tawḍeḍ talɣa tunṣibt.

strings.tools.redimensionner.options.width.label: Teɣzi (ipiksilen)
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.ratio.label: Talɣa
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.keywords: resize image, reduce photo size, crop image online, resize photo, make image smaller, square image
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[0]: Sewwet tugna taẓarant i tceḍt neɣ taseknit n zun-zih.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[1]: Ẓẓel tugna d amkuẓ i tmunelt.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[2]: Wوجد tugniwin 16:9 i useknu neɣ tasmel.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.steps[1].text: Tasemlit tessekanay-d aḥric i yettwaḥarben d teɣzi tamaynut.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[0].a: Tugna tamecṭuḥt tesseɛu ipiksilen drus maca teqqim d taḥerrart deg teɣzi-s tamaynut.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].q: Anwa wadeg i deg i d-yettwassen uẓẓel?
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].a: Deg tlemmast n tugna: iɣefawen ttwakksen s lemɣawla akken ad awḍen talɣa i yettwafen, akken i tessekanay tasemlit.
